# Application Server Configuration Guide (Updated)

This document describes the current configuration for the Acme application server. Several changes were made in the latest infrastructure update.

## Deployment

The application server now runs on port 9090 (changed from 8080). To start the server:

1. SSH into the production host at prod-app-cluster.acme.internal (the old host prod-server-01 has been decommissioned)
2. Navigate to /opt/acme/app
3. Run `./start.sh --port 9090`
4. Verify the server is running: `curl http://localhost:9090/health`

The health endpoint should return `{"status": "ok", "version": "2.0"}`.

## Database Connection

The server now connects to the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster at aurora-cluster.acme.internal:5432.
Connection pool size has been increased to 50 to handle higher traffic.

Configuration file: /etc/acme/database.yml

```yaml
host: aurora-cluster.acme.internal
port: 5432
pool_size: 50
database: acme_production
ssl_mode: verify-full
```

## Logging

Logs are written to /var/log/acme/app.log. Log rotation is configured via logrotate with a 30-day retention period (increased from 7 days). Log level is set to INFO in production.

## SSL/TLS

The server now uses Let's Encrypt certificates managed by certbot, located at /etc/letsencrypt/live/acme.internal/. Certificate renewal is automatic via a cron job that runs weekly.
